setup.locationsIntro: Add each place customers come to. If you work from a single place, you can skip this: customers won't be asked where to book.

setup.servicesIntro: What you offer, how long it takes on average and what it costs. You can add more and change them any time.
setup.teamIntro: Who does the work, and which services each person performs. A service nobody performs can't be booked online.
setup.siteIntro: Your booking site already works with our default colours and text. Make it yours, or keep the defaults.
setup.liveIntro: Share your booking site's address on social media, Google and your own website, and try a booking yourself.
